text:
devon: FYI — HelixPay onboarding ticket T-4298 escalated to P1. SSO flow failing for ~40% of users; trial cohort blocked and AE flagged renewal risk. @laura can you take lead? https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/T-4298

sam: cc @maria. Quick log dump shows 500 from auth relay, looks like missing `sub` claim in some JWTs. Snippet: ```ERR auth: KeyError 'sub' at auth_handler.py:87
RequestID=abc123
status=500```

laura: On it. Scheduling a warroom for 11:30 UTC. Need a comms plan for the customer + clear handoff. @devon can you confirm affected org IDs and whether a temporary fallback (email auth) is possible? :calendar:

devon: Affected orgs: org_helix_001, org_helix_test. We can flip to email auth as a fallback but that requires token rotation and a config toggle — approx 30m of ops work. Customer asked for a workaround while SSO is fixed.

maria: I can own customer comms. Draft message: "We're investigating SSO failures and can enable a temporary email-auth fallback. Would you like us to enable it now?" :email:

sam: Eng can push a hotfix today — root cause appears to be IdP sending malformed JWTs for some users. Patch is staged; need approval to push staging->prod. @oncall-bot can you confirm next deploy window?

oncall-bot: Deploy window requested by sam. Next available slot: 11:50-12:10 UTC. Please confirm.

laura: Confirmed 11:50. Warroom invite sent. @devon please capture runbook steps and the rollback plan in the handoff doc: https://docs.redwood.com/cs/hand-offs/helixpay-ssosync
devon: Logged step-by-step in the doc (steps 1-6). Also flagged account health: renewal risk=HIGH; AE requested a 90-day renewal extension if not resolved by EOD Friday.

maria: Noted. I'll prepare an extension offer template and loop in legal. Also capturing feedback: onboarding UX around IdP metadata is confusing — will add to VOC and draft a brief enablement note for AEs.

laura: Thanks all. After the warroom we'll follow up with the customer, enable the fallback if they'd like, and run weekly check-ins until the renewal closes. Closing the escalation thread here — will post updates in the handoff doc and ping this thread with final resolution. :white_check_mark:
